incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PDR-9218 — prod-web: LB target health & TLS handshake failures (multiple 5xx, client TLS errors) :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Triggered for rotation rule: lb-health-check-failure x5 in 2m. Escalation policy: infra-oncall -> alice -> ben.
alice: ack — I'm on it, grabbing context.
ben: on-call network — joining. initial checks: beginning with LB target list and DNS.
clara: infra here, checking recent deploys and cert rotations. No deploys in last 30m in prod-web.
emma: support seeing customer reports: several customers hitting 503/524 from api.redwood.ai and some TLS handshake errors in logs. Collating customer request IDs.
alice: okay, first quick health checks: `aws elb describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-prod-web` and `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:10.0.0.12`. If anyone sees `SSL handshake` on LB logs, paste it.
ben: LB target health shows ~40% unhealthy across us-east-1 target group. Health reason: TLS alert handshake_failure in the NGINX error logs on the targets.
clara: checking certs: cert in SecretsManager for `prod-web` rotated ~2h ago, thumbprint changed. kube secret updated 1.5h ago. Rolling restart of web pods started ~1.4h ago.
dave: could be cert mismatch between LB and backend or SNI issue. Any config changes on the LB side?
ben: No manual LB change. But I see from cloudtrail: autoscaling group replaced some instances due to instance health check failures ~1.3h ago. New instances bootstrapped with nginx config from AMI bake that references old cert name `prod-web-v2` while SecretsManager now has `prod-web-v3`.
alice: that explains TLS handshake mismatch — backend presents wrong cert; clients fail handshake at LB/backend TLS passthrough. Mitigation options: 1) quick rollback to previous secret; 2) force restart new pods after updating secret mount; 3) take target out of LB and replace with healthy ones.
clara: I can patch the Deployment to point to the new secret name used by the AMI or update the AMI, but that's slower. Short-term: rotate LB target group to only include instances with correct cert (manual target deregistration).
ben: I'll mark unhealthy targets out to stop traffic to them `aws elb deregister-targets --target-group-arn TG --targets Id=i-...`. Then we can bring up a small replacement ASG with correct bootstrap.
emma: ETA to customers? We should post a Statuspage incident now — degraded service for API endpoints. I can draft the message.
dave: do it, say "partial outage affecting some API requests; engineering investigating TLS handshake failures; mitigation in progress".
emma: posted draft and scheduled update. statuspage: INC-2025-03 posted. :white_check_mark:
alice: temporary mitigation: removing bad targets reduced 5xx rate by ~70% within 2m. Continue with replacement plan.
clara: working on automated job to re-bake AMI with correct cert reference and push to ASG. ETA ~25-30m.
ben: started replacing targets and adding canary instances with correct cert. Monitoring logs for `SSL: certificate verify` and `handshake_failure`.
emma: customers asking for workaround: advise using retry/backoff; some clients get cached TLS errors until next connection attempt. Communicated in support thread.
alice: log snippets for diagnostics (sanitized):
```
[error] 2025-10-12T23:45:12Z TLS handshake failed: alert handshake_failure (maybe wrong cert/SNI)
[info] 2025-10-12T23:47:02Z target deregistered i-0a1b2c3d
```
ben: good catch. After deregistering bad hosts, LB 5xx dropped. Still watching DNS TTLs in case some clients are pinned to old endpoints.
clara: DNS propagation looks clean; no changes recently. This was a cert/bootstrap mismatch. Recording remediation steps in runbook.
dave: next steps: 1) finish replacing ASG instances with baked AMI (clara), 2) validate full target health (ben), 3) notify customers and clear incident when stable (emma), 4) postmortem owner (alice).
emma: prep customer follow-up note — will send once traffic stable for 30m.
alice: handing off to ben for overnight watch at 00:00 UTC — I'll be offline after handoff. Ben, you own until I return.
ben: taking over, ack. I'll post another update in 30m and ping if anything regresses. :eyes:
incident-bot: PDR-9218 acknowledged by alice. Current status: mitigated -> partial, monitoring.
clara: patch job started, AMI bake ok so far, will trigger rolling restart on new ASG. ETA 20m.
ben: observed a small spike in retries but overall success rate back to 99.2% for affected endpoints. Continuing watch.
emma: customer update 1 sent. Waiting on 30m stability window before final.
dave: thanks everyone. We'll capture root cause: cert/AMI config drift during secret rotation -> plan followup to tighten bootstrap SRs.
alice: closing the PagerDuty incident if stable after 60m. For now keeping on-call watch.
ben: 30m passed, no regression. Logging follow-up items in #postmortems.
emma: final customer email queued pending ops go/no-go.
clara: bake complete, pushing asg update now.
ben: thanks — I'll mark last check at 1753511200 and update statuspage if all good.
incident-bot: PDR-9218 status update: monitoring -> resolved (will be closed after confirmation).
